title: iPhone Duo
summary:
The **iPhone Duo** is Apple’s first foldable smartphone, featuring a durable grade-5 titanium frame and a 7.6-inch Super Retina XDR inner display—the largest ever on an iPhone. When unfolded, it offers a 50% larger viewing area than the iPhone 18 Pro Max, while the outer display maintains a nearly full-screen experience.

**Design and Versatility**
The device is powered by **iOS 27**, specifically reimagined for foldable hardware. It supports various orientations, such as "Seated" for hands-free viewing and "Standing" for StandBy mode. Users can leverage the expansive inner screen for Split View multitasking or a wider keyboard in portrait mode.

**Performance and Battery**
At its core is the **A20 Pro chip**, featuring a vapor-chamber cooling system and a 16-core Neural Engine optimized for intensive AI workloads. The iPhone-first **dual-battery system** delivers exceptional longevity, offering up to 44 hours of video playback on the outer display and 31 hours on the inner display, with fast charging reaching 50% in 20 minutes.

**Camera and AI**
The 48MP Dual Fusion camera system introduces foldable-specific features:
*   **Duo Preview:** Allows subjects to see themselves on the outer display.
*   **Kid Cue:** Uses animations on the outer screen to get children to look at the lens.
*   **Smart Take:** Automatically detects when everyone is ready for a photo.
*   **Under-Display Camera:** A hidden FaceTime camera provides an uninterrupted viewing surface.

**Siri AI and Safety**
Deeply integrated with **Apple Intelligence**, the new **Siri AI** offers conversational assistance, personal context awareness, and generative writing tools. Safety and connectivity are bolstered by Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and expanded satellite services for messaging and emergency assistance.

Pre-orders begin October 16, with full availability starting October 23.
chinese_title: iPhone 双项
chinese_summary:
**iPhone Duo** 是 Apple 首款折叠屏智能手机，采用坚固耐用的 5 级钛金属边框，并配备 7.6 英寸超视网膜 XDR 内屏——这是 iPhone 史上尺寸最大的显示屏。展开后，其可视面积比 iPhone 18 Pro Max 增加 50%，而外屏则保持了近乎全屏的使用体验。

**设计与多功能性**
该设备搭载专为折叠屏硬件重新构思的 **iOS 27** 系统。它支持多种放置形态，例如用于免手持观看的“坐立”模式和用于待机显示的“站立”模式。用户可以利用宽大的内屏进行 Split View 多任务处理，或在纵向模式下使用更宽的键盘。

**性能与电池**
其核心搭载 **A20 Pro 芯片**，配备真空腔均热板散热系统和专为高强度 AI 工作负载优化的 16 核神经网络引擎。iPhone 首创的**双电池系统**带来了卓越的续航表现：外屏视频播放时间最长可达 44 小时，内屏最长可达 31 小时，通过快充仅需 20 分钟即可充至 50% 电量。

**摄像头与 AI**
4800 万像素融合双摄系统引入了折叠屏专属功能：
*   **Duo 预览：** 让拍摄对象能够通过外屏看到自己。
*   **儿童引导 (Kid Cue)：** 通过外屏动画吸引孩子看向镜头。
*   **智能拍摄 (Smart Take)：** 自动检测所有人是否已准备好拍照。
*   **屏下摄像头：** 隐藏式 FaceTime 摄像头提供无遮挡的完整视觉表面。

**Siri AI 与安全**
全新 **Siri AI** 与 **Apple 智能**深度集成，提供对话式辅助、个人情境感知及生成式写作工具。在连接与安全方面，支持 Wi-Fi 7、蓝牙 6 以及扩展的卫星服务，用于信息收发和紧急求助。

10 月 16 日开启预购，10 月 23 日正式发售。

title: AirPods 5
summary:
On September 9, 2026, Apple announced the **AirPods 5**, featuring a major advancement in open-ear Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) that removes 50% more external noise than the previous generation. The lineup consists of two models: a base version for **$129** and a version with a Wireless Charging Case for **$149**.

**Key Audio and Design Enhancements:**
The AirPods 5 utilize a new multiport acoustic architecture and next-generation Adaptive EQ to provide more immersive sound and Personalized Spatial Audio. The $149 model introduces a force sensor with **volume swipe**—the first time on-stem volume control has been available for the open-ear design. It also features an improved battery, offering five hours of playback with ANC on a single charge and up to 22 total hours with the case. Both models feature enhanced durability against dust, sweat, and water.

**Intelligence and Connectivity:**
Deeply integrated with **Apple Intelligence and iOS 27**, the AirPods 5 introduce "Siri AI," a more conversational assistant capable of understanding personal context across apps like Mail and Messages. New features include:
*   **Live Translation:** Allows users to hear real-time translations by pressing the stems or using Siri.
*   **Siri Interactions:** Users can respond to Siri discreetly by nodding or shaking their heads.
*   **Voice Improvements:** Advanced computational audio for more natural Transparency and Adaptive Audio modes.

**Sustainability and Availability:**
Reflecting Apple’s 2030 carbon-neutral goals, the AirPods 5 are made with 40% recycled materials. Pre-orders begin today, with full retail availability starting **Friday, September 18**.

秉承 Apple 2030 年碳中和目标，AirPods 5 采用 40% 的再生材料制造。新品即日起开启预订，并将于 **9 月 18 日（星期五）**正式发售。

title: Tailwind Labs is joining Shopify
summary:
Tailwind Labs, the creator of the popular Tailwind CSS framework, has announced that it is joining Shopify. After nine years of independent growth—reaching over 110 million weekly installs and powering major platforms like X and Reddit—the team is moving to Shopify to provide the framework with a stable, long-term home.

**Key Reasons for the Move:**
*   **Real-World Application:** The team wants to develop Tailwind in service of a complex, large-scale product. Shopify’s vast ecosystem—including merchant storefronts, checkout experiences, and "agentic commerce"—provides the ideal environment to solve real-world UI challenges and innovate.
*   **Existing Partnership:** Shopify was an early adopter of Tailwind CSS and considers it a "load-bearing" part of its technical stack, ensuring a vested interest in its continued maintenance.
*   **Mission Alignment:** Founder Adam Wathan cited a personal alignment with Shopify’s mission to empower entrepreneurs as a driving factor.

**Impact on Users and Products:**
*   **Open Source:** Tailwind CSS and other open-source projects will remain MIT-licensed. The original team will continue to lead and maintain these projects with Shopify’s backing.
*   **Commercial Products:** Tailwind is shifting away from its independent business model. While existing customers of Tailwind Plus and ui.sh will maintain full access, new sign-ups are now closed. 

Ultimately, the acquisition allows the Tailwind team to stop focusing on business growth and instead dedicate their efforts to evolving the framework within the Shopify ecosystem.
chinese_title: Tailwind Labs 加入 Shopify
chinese_summary:

**加入 Shopify 的核心原因：**
*   **真实应用场景：** 团队希望围绕复杂的大型产品来开发 Tailwind。Shopify 庞大的生态系统——包括商家店面、结账体验以及“代理商业（agentic commerce）”——为解决真实的 UI 挑战和进行创新提供了理想环境。
*   **现有的合作伙伴关系：** Shopify 是 Tailwind CSS 的早期采用者，并将其视为技术栈中“承重”的关键部分，这确保了其对框架持续维护的切身利益。
*   **使命一致：** 创始人 Adam Wathan 表示，他个人对 Shopify “赋能创业者”使命的认同是促成此次决定的一个重要因素。

**对用户和产品的影响：**
*   **开源项目：** Tailwind CSS 及其它开源项目将继续保留 MIT 许可。在 Shopify 的支持下，原团队将继续领导并维护这些项目。
*   **商业产品：** Tailwind 正在告别其独立的商业模式。虽然 Tailwind Plus 和 ui.sh 的现有客户仍可拥有全部访问权限，但新用户注册通道现已关闭。

总之，此次收购让 Tailwind 团队能够不再专注于业务增长，转而全身心地投入到 Shopify 生态系统中，致力于推动该框架的进一步演进。

title: What do Visa and Mastercard do? An intro to card networks
summary:
Visa and Mastercard are not banks, card issuers, or payment processors; instead, they function as **card networks** that connect cardholders and their banks (issuers) with merchants and their banks (acquirers). Their primary role is to facilitate the complex ecosystem of electronic payments through four key responsibilities:

1.  **Telecommunications:** They operate massive, highly secure global data centers and fiber-optic networks to route transaction messages. This includes **authorization** (checking for funds) and **clearing** (finalizing the transaction amount).
2.  **Banking Coordination:** They manage the financial settlement process, ensuring money moves from the issuer to the acquirer. They utilize "net settlement" to move funds efficiently and act as an international adapter for currency conversion.
3.  **Incentives and Fees:** Networks set the fees that sustain the ecosystem. While the network takes a small assessment fee, they set the **interchange fee** paid to the issuing bank. This high interchange rate incentivizes banks to offer rewards programs, which in turn encourages consumer spending and merchant acceptance.
4.  **Rules and Dispute Resolution:** The networks maintain massive rulebooks governing brand usage and transaction standards. They also provide a structured **arbitration mechanism** for disputes (chargebacks), allowing cardholders and merchants to resolve conflicts without involving the legal system.

Ultimately, these networks maintain a "virtuous cycle": by balancing fees and protections, they ensure that more consumers use cards and more merchants accept them, driving the global growth of electronic commerce.
chinese_title: Visa 和 Mastercard 是做什么的？卡组织简介
chinese_summary:
Visa和Mastercard并非银行、发卡机构或支付处理器；相反，它们作为**卡组织**，连接着持卡人及其银行（发卡行）与商家及其银行（收单行）。其主要职责是通过以下四项核心任务来促进复杂的电子支付生态系统：

1. **电信传输：** 它们运营着庞大且高度安全的全球数据中心和光纤网络，用于路由交易信息。这包括**授权**（核实资金）和**清算**（最终确定交易金额）。
2. **银行协作：** 它们管理资金结算流程，确保资金从发卡行转移至收单行。它们利用“净额结算”实现高效的资金转移，并充当货币转换的国际适配器。
3. **激励与费率：** 卡组织设定维持生态系统运行的费用。在收取少量评估费的同时，它们设定了支付给发卡行的**交换费**。较高的交换费率能激励银行提供奖励计划，进而鼓励消费者支出和商家受理。
4. **规则与争议解决：** 卡组织维护着监管品牌使用和交易标准的庞大规则手册。它们还为争议（拒付）提供结构化的**仲裁机制**，使持卡人和商家无需通过法律系统即可解决冲突。

最终，这些网络维持着一个“良性循环”：通过平衡费用与保护机制，它们确保了更多消费者使用卡片、更多商家受理卡片，从而驱动全球电子商务的增长。

title: Apple Watch Ultra 4
summary:
The Apple Watch Ultra 4, launching September 18, introduces significant advancements in battery life, health monitoring, and artificial intelligence. Retaining its rugged aerospace-grade titanium design (now available in Natural and Black finishes), the device is WR100-rated for diving and MIL-STD-810H tested for extreme durability.

**Battery and Performance**
The Ultra 4 offers the longest battery life in the lineup, featuring up to 50 hours of normal use and 84 hours in Low Power Mode. For endurance athletes, a new "Max Extended Workout" mode provides 45 hours of GPS tracking. Additionally, a 15-minute fast charge now yields 18 hours of use.

**Advanced Health Sensing**
A redesigned Health Sensing System utilizes more powerful sensors and efficient LEDs to provide the most accurate heart rate data in a wearable. It tracks background heart rate every five seconds and Heart Rate Variability (HRV) every five minutes. New metrics include:
*   **Readiness Score:** A daily energy capacity rating based on sleep and vitals.
*   **Health Age:** Insights into how habits affect longevity.
*   **Hypertension Notifications:** An algorithm that detects potential high blood pressure patterns over 30 days.

**Siri AI and Audio Intelligence**
Powered by the S11 chip, the Ultra 4 introduces "Siri AI" for natural, context-aware conversations. Late 2026 will see the rollout of "Audio Intelligence" features, such as **Live Rewind** (transcribing the last 15 seconds of audio) and **Siri Recap** (summarizing conversations).

**Safety and Connectivity**
The watch features built-in satellite communications for off-grid connectivity, Sound Recognition for the hearing impaired, and precision dual-frequency GPS. Combined with the redesigned Health app and customizable Action button, the Ultra 4 positions itself as a comprehensive tool for both elite performance and proactive health management.
chinese_title: Apple Watch Ultra 4
chinese_summary:
Apple Watch Ultra 4 将于 9 月 18 日发布，在电池续航、健康监测和人工智能方面带来了重大突破。该设备延续了坚固的航空级钛金属设计（现提供原色和黑色饰面），具备 WR100 潜水级防水性能，并经过 MIL-STD-810H 极端耐用性测试。

**电池与性能**
Ultra 4 提供该系列中最长的电池续航：正常使用可达 50 小时，低电量模式下可达 84 小时。针对耐力运动员，全新的“极限运动模式”（Max Extended Workout）可提供 45 小时的 GPS 追踪。此外，快速充电 15 分钟即可支持 18 小时使用。

**先进健康感应**
重新设计的健康感应系统采用更强大的传感器和高效 LED，提供可穿戴设备中最精准的心率数据。它每 5 秒追踪一次背景心率，每 5 分钟追踪一次心率变异性（HRV）。新增指标包括：
*   **身体状态评分 (Readiness Score)：** 根据睡眠和生命体征评定的每日能量水平。
*   **健康年龄：** 洞察生活习惯对长寿的影响。
*   **高血压通知：** 通过算法检测 30 天内的潜在高血压模式。

在 S11 芯片的驱动下，Ultra 4 引入了支持自然、情境感知对话的“Siri AI”。2026 年底将推出“音频智能”功能，包括 **实时回溯 (Live Rewind)**（转录过去 15 秒的音频）和 **Siri 摘要 (Siri Recap)**（总结对话内容）。

**安全与连接**
这款手表内置卫星通信功能，支持离网连接，并具备针对听障人士的声音识别功能以及精准双频 GPS。结合重新设计的健康 App 和可自定义的操作按钮，Ultra 4 定位于兼顾卓越性能与主动健康管理的综合工具。

title: Qwen 3.8 follows GPT-5.5 Pro reasoning prefills
summary:
This report details version 1.1 of an experiment investigating "reasoning prefills," where the first 1% of a "teacher" model's reasoning (GPT-5.5 Pro) is inserted into the reasoning channel of several open "target" models. The goal was to measure how much this influence causes the target model’s final answer to align with the teacher’s output across 45 STEM, non-STEM, and synthetic puzzle problems.

**Key Findings:**
*   **Qwen3.8 A95B:** Showed the most significant reaction to the prefill, with its alignment with GPT-5.5 Pro jumping from **16.79% to 34.97%** (+18.18 pp). The effect was strongest in **STEM subjects**, which saw a massive **+26.99 pp** increase. 
*   **Kimi K3:** Maintained the highest overall overlap with the teacher model (over 35% when prefilled) but showed a much smaller delta (+4.54 pp) compared to its unprefilled state.
*   **DeepSeek V4 Flash & Inkling:** Showed negligible or slightly negative changes, suggesting little to no reliance on the teacher’s reasoning path.

**Conclusion:**
The data suggests a strong likelihood that **Qwen 3.8 was trained on data from GPT-5.5 Pro** or a closely related model. While previous experiments showed Qwen had little alignment with Opus 4.8, its high responsiveness to GPT-5.5 Pro’s reasoning prefills—even on private synthetic puzzles—indicates a specific "stolen thoughts" relationship or training influence from the GPT family.
chinese_title: Qwen 3.8 沿袭 GPT-5.5 Pro 的推理预填充
chinese_summary:
本报告详细介绍了 1.1 版本的实验，旨在研究“推理预填充”（reasoning prefills）。实验将“教师”模型（GPT-5.5 Pro）前 1% 的推理内容插入到多个开源“目标”模型的推理通道中。该研究旨在通过 45 个涵盖 STEM、非 STEM 及合成谜题的问题，衡量这种干预在多大程度上使目标模型的最终答案与教师模型的输出趋于一致。

**主要发现：**
*   **Qwen3.8 A95B：** 对预填充表现出最显著的反应，其与 GPT-5.5 Pro 的一致性从 **16.79% 跃升至 34.97%**（+18.18 个百分点）。在 **STEM 学科**中影响最为剧烈，增幅达 **26.99 个百分点**。
*   **Kimi K3：** 与教师模型保持了最高的整体重合度（预填充时超过 35%），但与未预填充状态相比，其增量（+4.54 个百分点）要小得多。
*   **DeepSeek V4 Flash & Inkling：** 变化微乎其微甚至略有负增长，表明它们几乎不依赖教师模型的推理路径。

**结论：**
数据表明，**Qwen 3.8 极有可能是基于 GPT-5.5 Pro** 或与其高度相关的模型数据训练而成的。尽管之前的实验显示 Qwen 与 Opus 4.8 的一致性较低，但它对 GPT-5.5 Pro 推理预填充的高度响应（甚至在私有合成谜题上也是如此）表明，它与 GPT 系列模型之间存在特定的“思想窃取”（stolen thoughts）关系或训练影响。

title: GNU Radio in the browser
summary:
**GNU Radio World** is a web-based implementation of the GNU Radio Companion flowgraph editor and runtime, allowing users to design and execute software-defined radio (SDR) applications directly in a browser. 

By leveraging **WebAssembly**, the platform compiles the GNU Radio DSP stack and Qt GUI sinks to run entirely on the client side. This eliminates the need for Python, local installations, or backend servers. Key features and capabilities include:

*   **Hardware Integration:** It interfaces directly with SDR hardware—including RTL-SDR, PlutoSDR, and HackRF—using **WebUSB**.
*   **Native Compatibility:** The tool reads and writes standard `.grc` files, ensuring seamless interoperability with native GNU Radio installations.
*   **Real-Time Visualization:** Users can view live spectrum, waterfall, and constellation plots immediately upon running a flowgraph.
*   **Built-in Resources:** The platform ships with example flowgraphs and IQ recordings to help users get started quickly.

In summary, GNU Radio World provides a portable, zero-install environment for DSP experimentation, making SDR more accessible by bringing the full power of the GNU Radio ecosystem to a standard web browser.
